in_marathi.name: Priyanshvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Loved by Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Priyanshvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Priya means beloved and Ansh means Shiva, so this name means 'Loved by Shiva'. It is a rare and spiritual name that is deeply rooted in Hindu tradition.
